title: 药店与小病

words.example: Do I need a prescription for this?
I need some medicine for a cold.
I have an allergy to peanuts.

sentences.en: I have a sore throat and a mild fever.
sentences.speak: I have a sore throat and a mild fever.

sentences.en: Do I need a prescription for this?
sentences.speak: Do I need a prescription for this?

sentences.zh: 成人用法用量是怎样的？

sentences.en: Can I take this with food?
sentences.zh: 这个可以和食物一起吃吗？
sentences.speak: Can I take this with food?

scenarios.title: 问路找药店
scenarios.setting: 在街上找药店买感冒药，向路人打听。

lines.en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy nearby?
lines.zh: 不好意思，附近有药店吗？
lines.speak: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy nearby?

lines.en: Yes, there's one two blocks down on the left.
lines.zh: 有，往前走两个街区，左边那家。
lines.speak: Yes, there's one two blocks down on the left.

scenarios.title: 跟店员说明症状
scenarios.setting: 进药店后向药剂师描述轻微感冒症状，询问非处方药。

lines.en: I have a sore throat and a mild fever.
lines.speak: I have a sore throat and a mild fever.

lines.en: How long have you had these symptoms?
lines.speak: How long have you had these symptoms?

lines.en: Since yesterday. Do I need a prescription?
lines.zh: 从昨天开始。需要处方吗？
lines.speak: Since yesterday. Do I need a prescription?

lines.en: No. This cold medicine should help. Take it with food.
lines.zh: 不用。这个感冒药应该有用。随餐服用。
lines.speak: No. This cold medicine should help. Take it with food.

lines.zh: 成人用法用量是怎样的？

lines.en: One tablet every six hours. Don't take more than four a day.
lines.zh: 每六小时一片，一天不超过四片。
lines.speak: One tablet every six hours. Don't take more than four a day.

task: 把「找药店 + 说症状 + 问剂量」六句连说两遍并录音自听
